description: Ordered operation lists over attachment content and its content-addressed blob files: dedupe, garbage collection on delete and clear, and reads after a reopen. Same op and expected rules as ops-chats.json.

cases.name: stores attachment content and reads it back intact
stores one blob for the same image pasted into two chats
keeps several distinct attachments on one message, in order
collects an orphaned blob once the chat is deleted
keeps a shared blob alive while another chat still references it
keeps attachments attached to the right copy when message ids repeat
collectGarbage removes nothing while every blob is referenced
clearing every chat leaves no blobs behind
an empty attachment is stored and read back as empty text
a blob whose file is gone reads as empty text, and its row still counts
a blob shared by two chats stays until the last chat that uses it goes
removing a chat removes only the files of attachments nothing else uses
clearing every chat removes every blob file
